content_of_post_to_answer: What are some ways that teenage boys can be encouraged to ask for help when they need it?
answer: Many teenage boys avoid asking for help not because they lack problems, but because they interpret needing help as evidence that they are failing. The goal is not to make them more dependent; it is to redefine strength as knowing when another perspective is needed. I’ve explored this pattern in more detail on my Quora profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. A boy who learns that asking for help preserves his ability to solve problems is learning a skill that lasts far beyond adolescence.
